prime_minister.name: Elena Markova
prime_minister.description: The Prime Minister. Strong anti-corruption stance, pro-EU reformist. Under pressure from coalition partners and opposition.

finance.name: Stefan Dimitrov
finance.description: Technocratic finance minister, trusted by EU and IMF. Pushes for fiscal discipline. Not popular with social coalition partners.

interior.name: Ivan Borisov
interior.description: Career police official. Loyal but has old security service connections. Moderate corruption risk. Manages protests.

foreign_affairs.name: Nadia Popova
foreign_affairs.description: Experienced diplomat, former EU official. Strong pro-Western credentials. Excellent for EU negotiations.

justice.name: Georgi Hristov
justice.description: LD appointment. Centrist lawyer, supports judicial reform. Loyalty to coalition is conditional on LD's satisfaction.

economy.name: Petya Vasileva
economy.description: SD appointment. Pro-labor economics. Pushes for industrial jobs and wage rises. Clashes with Finance Ministry.

health.name: Kamen Ivanov
health.description: Former hospital director. Moderate competence. Higher corruption risk — pharmaceutical sector is lucrative and tempting.

education.name: Zorka Stancheva
education.description: GF appointment. Progressive educator, anti-corruption. Excellent public image. Strong commitment to the coalition.

regional_development.name: Yordan Petkov
regional_development.description: Controls large EU infrastructure budget. Highest corruption risk in cabinet. Previous minister resigned over similar concerns.

energy.name: Lubomir Zarev
energy.description: SD appointment with connections to energy sector. Under scrutiny over gas contracts. Coalition loyalty shaky.
